The structure of Na3Y2F10 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 15 atoms per unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies octahedral Y centers coordinated by six F neighbors, while Na centers show four F neighbors, one Na orbit with 10 F neighbors, and a second Na orbit with two F neighbors. The Y-centered octahedra share corners and edges, and corner-sharing also occurs between the 10-vertex Na polyhedra and the Y octahedra; the geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional.
